statistical_notes.confidence_intervals: Continuous per-seed metrics use two-sided 95% Student-t confidence intervals; binary recovery proportions use two-sided 95% Wilson intervals; paired policy comparisons use within-seed differences. These intervals describe uncertainty under this configured simulation, not field-network uncertainty.
statistical_notes.decision_time: Decision compute time uses one wall-clock perf_counter boundary around controller.observe; only calls that emit a new decision are accumulated. Total run time and mean/p95 per decision are reported separately from simulated recovery time.
statistical_notes.latency: Latency is conditional on successful user-time connections. Each policy has its own successful-user sample set; latency is summarized separately and is not treated as a paired comparison.
statistical_notes.p95: Per-seed P95 uses nearest-rank. The aggregate pooled P95 is calculated over all successful user-time latency samples across seeds.
statistical_notes.rates: Per-seed user-time rates use the same number of opportunities for all policies; summaries are equal-weight means across seeds.
statistical_notes.raw_latency_samples: Phase 4 seed records include each successful user-time latency sample so pooled conditional summaries can be independently recomputed.
statistical_notes.recovery: Unrecovered runs remain null. Recovery-time mean and median include only recovered runs and are reported with recovered/unrecovered counts; no timeout value is imputed.
statistical_notes.recovery_censoring: network_recovery_or_censoring_time_s is T when recovered and the simulation horizon when not recovered; recovery success and recovered-only times remain separately reported.
statistical_notes.shared_safety_policy: B is retained as the historical grid planner. Bprime uses the same grid destination with a common conservative sortie budget including movement, hover, relay, service horizon, return, and reserve. C, D, and the runtime actuator use the same Wh rates and return-hover reserve helper.
statistical_notes.sustained_recovery: A sustained recovery requires all rescue users connected for 30 seconds continuously (four observations at 10-second sampling); the reported time is the first observation in that run.
statistical_notes.uav_attribution: Ground-only rescue service is recomputed each tick with the same topology, demand, and positions but drone_active=false. UAV-relayed service counts rescue outcomes whose selected path_kind is drone_relay. Extra UAV service is max(0, actual connected rescue count minus ground-only connected rescue count) per interval.
statistical_notes.uav_energy_per_service: Wh per rescue-user-hour divides total UAV energy by actual rescue user-seconds routed over drone_relay. It is null when no such service was delivered.
